limitations: No camera connection, firmware installation or card write
DC preset geometry, non-HD K dimensions and 1..16384 input limits are editable prototype examples, not verified hardware capabilities
Millimetres use approximate linear calibration from the official 35.9x23.9mm sensor size to the preview 6000x4000 OG window; actual sensor readout calibration is unverified
RAW14, bit depth/FPS combinations, pixel alignment and real sensor window support are not validated; FPS options were not expanded
Browser presentation is not execution of the portable C model

C core retains legacy edit commit/cancel APIs; immediate persistence, trash removal, slide paging, decimal aspect labels, double tap, upward navigation, RES/DC bounds and customization transitions are browser presentation policies

Browser gesture validation used native Mac mouse events and keyboard entry into reorder before a real coordinate drag; continuous held-touch drag and multi-touch cancellation require physical-device validation
No measured browser fps or input-to-display latency
Browser pointercancel and multi-touch for the new value strip still need a touch-device recheck; C tests do not execute the browser controller
Motion traces verify renderer writes and model commit timing, not physical display scan-out or camera performance
Native input automation did not deliver wheel events inside the iframe wrapper; horizontal wheel behavior was validated in the direct preview of the same fragment
Physical Mac trackpad momentum and subjective feel require human validation; native input routing and timed synthetic replay alone are not a smoothness verdict
